gloss: coming home after midnight; someone who does

definitions.gloss: coming home after midnight (from drinking or work); a person who does so
definitions.explanation: A humorous word for getting home in the small hours, or for the person (traditionally a husband) who does: back after midnight, that is in the {午前|ごぜん} (a.m.) hours. Used jokingly or as a mild complaint by family members.

examples.japanese: ⟦{夫|おっと}→夫：00982_otto⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦また→また：00969_mata⟧{午前様|ごぜんさま}だ。
examples.english: My husband came home after midnight again.

examples.japanese: ⟦{忘年会|ぼうねんかい}→忘年会：15800_bounenkai⟧⟦シーズン→シーズン：10944_shiizun⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{午前様|ごぜんさま}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}く→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧。
examples.english: During year-end party season, late-night homecomings go on and on.

examples.japanese: ⟦{昨日|きのう}→昨日：00859_kinou⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{飲|の}み{会|かい}→飲み会：09371_nomikai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{午前様|ごぜんさま}になって、⟦{妻|つま}→妻：01005_tsuma⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ひどく→ひどい：01097_hidoi⟧⟦{怒|おこ}られた→怒る：00876_okoru⟧。
examples.english: I got home after midnight from a drinking party again yesterday, and my wife was really angry.

notes:
A play on ⟦{午前|ごぜん}→午前：00548_gozen⟧ (a.m.) + ⟦{様|さま}→様：01549_sama⟧ (an honorific, here ironic), as if the late arrival were an honoured guest. Mostly about drinking, but also used for overtime.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {午前様|ごぜんさま}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to end up coming home after midnight
- {午前様|ごぜんさま}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}く→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧: late nights keep happening
- ⟦また→また：00969_mata⟧{午前様|ごぜんさま}: home after midnight again

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{朝帰|あさがえ}り→朝帰り：08693_asagaeri⟧: coming home in the morning; even later, and often suggests a night spent elsewhere
